channel.title: SpaceX Daily (Français)
channel.description: The daily companion for following SpaceX as a public company (Nasdaq: SPCX). Starship, Falcon, Starlink, Dragon, the SPCX market picture, and the engineering and economics behind the push to make life multiplanetary — with sources, community buzz, one honest counterpoint every day, and a daily engineering deep dive. Not financial advice.
